forcedExit.title: A forced exit
forcedExit.body: On step {stepNumber} the position's virtual money touched the teaching maintenance level ({levelAmount}), so the teaching rule closed it at {settledAmount}. The rest of the path is shown for context only — those later prices were not recoverable.

survivedButHurt.title: The position survived
survivedButHurt.body: The position stayed open to the end, but the same path moved its virtual money {lossPct} at its worst point. Survival was not comfort: the swings were far larger than without borrowed exposure.

userExitedEarly.title: You exited
userExitedEarly.body: You closed the position on step {stepNumber} at {finalAmount}. An early exit changes the path you experience afterwards. It does not make one episode a forecast.

unleveragedSurvived.title: The unleveraged replay stayed open
unleveragedSurvived.body: Without borrowed exposure the identical path never reached the teaching maintenance level. The position stayed open to the end.

recoveryMaths.title: Recovery maths
recoveryMaths.body: This run ended at {finalAmount} from {startAmount}. Getting back to the starting amount from here needs a {requiredGainPct} gain, because the gain applies to a smaller base. A {lossPct} loss needs more than a {lossPct} gain. This is arithmetic, not a prediction.
